utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It's to raise money for fixing the community center roof.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, Uli, thanks for reminding me. I think I've got it now – the community center roof.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That's right. Thanks for helping out, Oren.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We need to check supplies before the weekend.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, Leo, heads up—the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center, not Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it, I'll check supplies for Sunday then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey, I heard we need paint and brushes. I can check my garage.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That's great, Bo! Bring them to the community center between 9 and noon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I'll swing by sometime in that window.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Heard you're organizing a repair drive. I've got a truck full of tools if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect timing, Gus! Actually, do you have any paint and brushes? I'm worried we're running low.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I've got a few cans of paint and some brushes in the truck. I'll grab 'em for you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I've been thinking about the repair drive, just need to sort out a few things first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That's great, Eli! Let me know if you need any help sorting things out—we are still on for tomorrow to update the flyers, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I've got the flyers ready to go. We'll meet at the community center at 10 AM sharp, as planned.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Well, Cleo's worried we might be short on paint and brushes. You know anyone who can spare some?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I sure hope we have enough. Maybe we should count what we already have before asking for more—I'd hate to end up with too much paint and not enough help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That's a smart idea, Pia! Let's do a quick inventory before I start asking around.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: It's at the community center on Maple Street, starting at 10 AM this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I already saw that on the schedule; I'll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, can't wait to see you there! Spread the word if you can.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Hana, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... maybe at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hmm, do you know what exactly they're fixing? I've heard it might be for playground equipment.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Playground equipment? That rings a bell... I think Cleo was talking about paint and brushes, so maybe they're sprucing up the slides and swings.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: What's this repair drive about, Sam?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It's a community effort to fix the roof on the community center. Lots of folks are chipping in.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, fixing the roof? That sounds like a good cause. Do you need any extra hands?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane, are you planning to go to the repair drive this weekend? I'm trying to figure out the exact time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, sorry I'm late to respond—can you remind me what time it starts? I'll definitely be there, maybe a bit behind schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I'm not sure of the exact time yet, but I'm asking around. I'll let you know once I find out!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It's going well, thanks! Just been helping around.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Glad to hear it! The neighborhood's really coming together for this.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, it's great to see everyone pitching in. Have you brought anything in for repair?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, my toaster's been acting up too. Maybe I should bring it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yeah, a toaster sounds perfect. I'll bring my old one too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Great, I'm glad we're both bringing our toasters. Do you know where exactly the drive is happening?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, are you planning to join the repair drive this weekend? We could use your help!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about this repair drive? I've heard some shady things about those.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Shady? No way, Kira! It's just a bunch of us fixing up the playground — all above board, I promise.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I see, that makes sense. I hadn't heard about that yet.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Just a heads up, the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center. I hope that still works for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sunday at the community center, got it. Thanks for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Bo, how's the repair drive going? Need a hand with anything?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam, yeah, we could use extra hands. Actually, Cleo's worried we might be short on paint and brushes—know anyone who can spare some?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure, I've got some paint and brushes in my garage. Want me to grab them?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Actually, I think Faye said she'll be at the community center from 9 to noon for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Good to know, I'll make sure the paint and brushes are ready for her.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that's great that you have supplies ready. Mina mentioned she's bringing her toaster, so hopefully that's helpful.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, have you heard about the repair drive this weekend? It's at the community center on Maple Street, starting at 10 AM Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the community center roof! Sorry, I keep mixing that up. Thanks for the reminder, Quinn.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: No problem at all, Oren! I hope to see you there—don't forget to bring your tools!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good morning, Faye. The repair drive is this Saturday at the community center. Have you signed up for any tasks?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Yes, I'll be there from 9 to noon to collect donations.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great, I'll make sure to note that on the schedule. Will you need any assistance setting up?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I'm late, Noah. What's the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? I think it's at the community center, but I'm not sure about the time—I've been so scattered lately.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No worries, I can check the flyer I picked up earlier. Let me grab it.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Well, the roof is leaking pretty badly, so we need to replace the shingles and fix some damaged beams.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds like a big job. Maybe the repair drive this weekend could help with that.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I hope the drive raises enough for the materials.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got a truck full of tools, just tell me what you need.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That's great, Gus! We could really use your help at the community center. Head over there and ask for Jules.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, I'll head over there now. Should I bring anything specific?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It's on track. Just checking supplies. Need paint and brushes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Good to know about the paint and brushes. I'll bring some from home. So, we're still on for tomorrow to update the flyers and plan for Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, tomorrow works. I'll bring the flyer draft.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I need to know the exact schedule and what they want me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the drive's this Saturday starting at 9 AM. And Cleo mentioned we're low on paint and brushes—any chance you can bring some?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Alright, 9 AM Saturday. Do they need a specific type of paint or just any?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mina! Just wanted to let you know the repair drive has been moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oh, thanks for the update. What time on Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I'm not sure yet—I'll check and get back to you!
